statements.status_notes: Druid uses log4j2 for all logging. The log4j 1.x jar is bundled as a transitive of hadoop-common but org.apache.log4j classes are never loaded. The vulnerable deserialization paths in SocketAppender and friends are never exercised.

Druid uses log4j2 (org.apache.logging.log4j) for all logging. The log4j 1.x jar is bundled as a transitive of hadoop-common via druid-iceberg-extensions, druid-parquet-extensions, druid-orc-extensions, and ranger-plugins-common, but no Druid or extension code loads org.apache.log4j classes. The vulnerable SocketServer is never instantiated.
